name: Nana-sama
source:
A diabolical master phantom thief terrorizing Tea Town, and the leader of the Red-headed Thieves. Whether or not she actually wants it, she will take it with her own hands.

She is a charismatic person who has such a skill that she once brought together a group of thieving cats in a desolate town.

Even today, she cheerfully follows her instincts, and if she can't find something interesting, she makes it happen herself.

[translated from the [url=http://alikore.studiohilite.com/nana.html]official website[/url]]
